chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
“What judgment is more just than the casting of lots when the matter is entrusted to Allah?”
“Does not Allah, the Exalted, say: ‘So he cast lots, and he was among the losers’?”

key_terms.الْأَمْرُ: the matter or affair to be decided
key_terms.الْقُرْعَةِ: the casting of lots as a method of decision
key_terms.الْمُدْحَضِينَ: those who were overruled or lost in the drawing
key_terms.قَضِيَّةٍ: a case or judgment under consideration

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith show that casting lots can be a just Islamic legal method?
ai.summary: This hadith affirms the justice of drawing lots when a matter is consigned to Allah. It supports this principle by citing a Qur'anic example, indicating that qur'ah can serve as a valid means of judgment in cases of uncertainty or competing claims.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.3391 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"What judgment is more just than the casting of lots (Qur'ah) when the matter is entrusted to Allah (swt)?

Does not Allah (swt), the Exalted, say:
'So they cast lots, and he was among the losers'?" (Surah As-Saffat 37:141)
